speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Trigger Finger (Stenosing Tenosynovitis) of the right ring finger. The inability to flex the DIP joint while it rests in extension, combined with pain and swelling, is classic for the finger being stuck in the "locked" or "bent" position. This suggests a mechanical blockage of the flexor tendon within the A1 or A2 pulley, likely due to the traumatic catching event. Do you experience a distinct clicking or snapping sensation when you attempt to straighten the finger?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
